shop.headline: Genuine Pearls and stones, strung by hand. Your new favorite piece is here*
shop.intro: Using all natural gemstones, every piece is designed and strung by hand. Shop the current collection, or ask about a piece made just for you.
shop.customText: Have a stone, a color or an occasion in mind? Send a note with what you're imagining and when you need it. I will reply with ideas and a quote, then make your piece by hand.
shop.about: em clare jewelry is a small, handmade jewelry studio run solely by me, Jennifer Clare, Based in Austin, Texas. I am inspired by timeless gemstones reimagined in modern style. Pieces are made one at a time or in small batches, and every order is packaged with care.
shop.ribbon: Hand crafted one piece at a time · Custom orders welcome
